name: WF-06: MLOps Monitor & Drift Detection Engine

parameters.query:
WITH recent_predictions AS (
  SELECT
    task_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 END) AS successful,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) AS errors,
    AVG(processing_time_ms) AS avg_time_ms,
    AVG(confidence_score) AS avg_confidence
  FROM ml_predictions_log
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  GROUP BY task_type
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT
    task_type,
    AVG(confidence_score) AS baseline_confidence,
    AVG(processing_time_ms) AS baseline_time_ms
  FROM ml_predictions_log
  WHERE created_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  GROUP BY task_type
)
SELECT
  r.task_type,
  r.total,
  r.successful,
  r.errors,
  ROUND(r.avg_time_ms::numeric, 0) AS avg_time_ms,
  ROUND(r.avg_confidence::numeric, 3) AS avg_confidence,
  ROUND(b.baseline_confidence::numeric, 3) AS baseline_confidence,
  ROUND(((b.baseline_confidence - r.avg_confidence) / NULLIF(b.baseline_confidence, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS drift_pct,
  CASE WHEN r.errors > r.total * 0.1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS high_error_rate
FROM recent_predictions r
LEFT JOIN baseline b USING (task_type)
ORDER BY r.task_type;

INSERT INTO model_performance_metrics (model_name, metric_name, metric_value, baseline_value, drift_detected, drift_magnitude, total_predictions, period_start, period_end, created_at)
SELECT
  unnest(ARRAY[{{ $json.metrics_report.map(m => "'" + m.model + "'").join(',') }}]) AS model_name,
  'confidence_avg' AS metric_name,
  unnest(ARRAY[{{ $json.metrics_report.map(m => m.avg_confidence || 0).join(',') }}]) AS metric_value,
  unnest(ARRAY[{{ $json.metrics_report.map(m => m.avg_confidence || 0).join(',') }}]) AS baseline_value,
  unnest(ARRAY[{{ $json.metrics_report.map(m => m.drift_detected).join(',') }}]) AS drift_detected,
  unnest(ARRAY[{{ $json.metrics_report.map(m => Math.abs(m.confidence_drift_pct || 0)).join(',') }}]) AS drift_magnitude,
  unnest(ARRAY[{{ $json.metrics_report.map(m => m.total_predictions_24h).join(',') }}]) AS total_predictions,
  NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AS period_start,
  NOW() AS period_end,
  NOW() AS created_at;

meta.description: MLOps Monitor - daily confidence drift detection, MLflow logging, admin alerts on anomalies
